contract.production_rule: Consumers must reject this lock unless status is complete, unresolved is empty, and every required source category is present and internally consistent.
contract.immutable_digest: sha256 followed by exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
contract.uniqueness_rule: Repository, action, target, package, architecture, and tool identities must be unique within their category.
contract.oci_chain_rule: The tag index digest must select exactly one descriptor for each approved OCI platform, and each selected manifest must name the locked config digest.
contract.floating_input_rule: Tags, branches, abbreviated commits, latest, unversioned package requests, and references unavailable from their canonical source are forbidden as locked values. Mutable tags may appear only as resolution provenance beside an immutable result.
